summary: GDS Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 earnings press release. The filing reports financial and operational results, including revenue growth, net income, and adjusted EBITDA. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer. As a non-US filing, this 6-K is equivalent to a US earnings release. No deal terms or transaction parameters are present.
